messages:
Alexa (Marketing): hey team — prepping slides + blog for the launch next week, need a short, tightly-scoped bench integrity check. asking for: reproducible artifacts, raw samples for a few highlighted prompts, and a checksum so marketing can cite provenance.
Mike (Data Science): +1. can you list which prompts and model variants you want? also what percentiles matter for the slides (p50/p95/p99)?
Alexa (Marketing): good q. we'll highlight: throughput at p50, cold-start p95, and token cost delta for quantized vs fp16. prompts: 6 short demo prompts (signup flow, summarization, code gen small snippet, multi-turn clarifying Q, SQL translation, and a long-context chunk ~1.5k tokens). model variants: "redwood-3b.fp16", "redwood-3b.q4_0", and the server-side fallback "redwood-3b-small".
Jia (Eng Runtime): got it. we can do a focused run but need the exact payload format and seed list. where should we store artifacts?
Alexa (Marketing): s3://redwood-marketing/launch/bench-artifacts/2512345678/ — put a manifest.json and raw_samples/ (one JSONL per variant) plus perf/ (histograms, warmup traces). manifest should include SHA256 checksums for each file and the run command.
Sam (ProdEng): pinging runbook constraints: BATCH=1 (to show lowest-latency config) and BATCH=8 (to show cost optimized) for each variant, 3 warmup iterations, sample size = 300 queries per prompt (total 1800 queries) or until 30m, whichever first. acceptance: matching response tokens within 1% across runs for determinism check.
Mike (Data Science): will do an initial small run (30 queries per prompt) to sanity-check output diffs. any hard requirement on seed / randomness?
Alexa (Marketing): include random_seed=42 for determinism in the main runs and record the actual RNG state in the manifest. also capture model logits dump for the 6 canonical prompts (just first 64 tokens) for our regression checks.
Jia (Eng Runtime): OK timeline — can start a smoke tomorrow, full rerun tomorrow evening. deliverable: tarball with raw_samples.jsonl, perf_histograms.png, manifest.json (with checksums), and a tiny README with the exact CLI/ENV. will the marketing team consume png + CSV?
Alexa (Marketing): yes png + CSV + raw JSONL. also please put a one-line human-readable provenance tag we can paste in blog footnote (e.g., "Run by Eng Runtime on host gpu-23, commit abcdef, 2026-03-22").
Sam (ProdEng): small note: quantized runs need a warm cache to be fair — we'll include both cold and warm measurements and tag them in the CSV (coldstart=true/false).
Mike (Data Science): quick clarification: for "token cost delta" do you want per-token cost or cost per completed response?
Alexa (Marketing): per-response and per-1000-tokens. both, please. we'll show per-response in the primary slide and put per-token in appendix.
Jia (Eng Runtime): confirmed. will also include top-line latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99), tail error rates, and memory footprints for each run. ci-bot: will you auto-upload run artifacts to S3 and post a thread when done?
ci-bot: artifacts upload scheduled — will post presigned URLs to this thread once upload completes.
Mike (Data Science): running initial smoke now (BATCH=1, 30 queries each). posting logs here in ~15m.
Alexa (Marketing): amazing — if smoke looks clean, can you prioritize the full runs and aim to have artifacts by EOD tomorrow? small ask: add a short note in manifest called "marketing_blurb" summarizing any caveats (e.g., "model warmed with 3 iterations; quantized variant uses q4_0 which can change logits slightly").
Jia (Eng Runtime): will add marketing_blurb and make sure manifest fields match the spec above. one more: do you want hashes signed with our release key or just plain SHA256?
Alexa (Marketing): signed if it's easy. otherwise plain SHA256 is fine but mark as unsigned. legal might ask later.
Sam (ProdEng): FYI — if any run shows >5% delta in p50 between repeats, we'll re-run with a different pin of CUDA driver and include driver versions in manifest.
Mike (Data Science): smoke finished — a few minor differences in the SQL translation prompt on quantized variant, attaching short diff (will add to raw_samples). looks within expected range; kicking off full runs now.
ci-bot: upload complete: https://s3.example/redwood-marketing/launch/bench-artifacts/2512345678/ (manifest.json, raw_samples/, perf/)
Jia (Eng Runtime): posted final manifest and signed checksums. linkage: commit abcdef12345, host gpu-23, runtime v2.8. Manifest includes: run_env, seed, sample_count, histograms, sha256s.
Alexa (Marketing): thanks all! i'll pull the PNGs + CSV and draft the slide copy. tagging this as done unless we find a regression. :party_popper:
